text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Ukrainean Foreign Minister Gennady Udovenko and his Macedonian counterpart Blagoj Handziski signed an economic cooperation agreement in Skopje on Tuesday.
- The first $39 million installment from the SAL credit has been made available to Macedonia, the remaining $21 million should be extended by March 21 next year.
- Macedonia's largest opposition party VMRO-DPMNE and the Liberal Party will start talks on new electoral laws and pressures on the government to hold early elections.
- Association of pensioners and Macedonian trade unions fear future changes of the pension insurance and social security systems restricting basic pensions.
- The constitutional court to decide on Wednesday the mode of removing the Albanian flag in front of the local municipal building in Gostivar. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +389 91 201 196
